name: Henry Wells

relationships.evidence: Hayes ch. VI-VII: Obadiah Wells, second son of Henry I (b. 1690, third son of William II); ch. VII 'Henry of Montague, son of Obadiah'

bioAdditions: Hayes (S1) gives his full line: William Wells I of Southold -> William II (b. 1660, m. 1681 Elizabeth Tuthill, daughter of John Tuthill 1635) -> Henry I (b. 7 Feb 1690) -> Obadiah (b. Nov 1716, d. Montague 27 May 1800) -> Dr. Henry. That puts him 4 generations below William Wells and 4 below John Tuthill (both 12 above John): 3rd cousin 8 times removed, twice over. One of the founders of Brattleboro's church society, he later moved to Montague, Mass. Hayes stresses that neither he nor his father was a Tory despite their New York loyalties in the Vermont dispute.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Every generation from William Wells is given in Hayes 1878 (a detailed compiled genealogy using wills and town records); also descends from John Tuthill (1635) via Elizabeth Tuthill.

sources.citation: Charles W. Hayes, William Wells of Southold and his Descendants (1878) (archive.org full text), pp. 33, 38, ch. VI-VII
sources.supports: Chapters III-VII: William II m. Elizabeth Tuthill; Henry I; Obadiah second son of Henry I; Henry of Montague son of Obadiah; Mary Wells great-aunt of Dr. Henry

sources.citation: Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), p. 7
